raw_media_policy: Raw licensed source images and detector crop JPGs were deleted before artifact upload. Only derived measurements, verified public metadata, screening rows and crop metadata were retained in the compute artifact.
interpretation: This run harmonizes the direct-image branch with the frozen Azami detector/crop/colour pipeline. It is a sensitivity/coverage bridge, not a replacement of the frozen global Azami dataset.
claim_boundary: Provenance only. The compute PR and source harmonization do not define discrete flower-colour states, evolutionary transitions, ancestry, convergence, adaptation or molecular reactivation.
